ml: Remove all ML components from selected fixed ensemble, preserving relative non-ML weights. If selection has no ML, use preregistered equal-weight quartet.
recovery: Hold corrected scores and outcomes fixed; compare full corrected common cohort with previously eligible identities on overlapping historical dates. risk: Ridge refitted without price_drawdown using only strictly matured training labels at each date.
